origin.summary: Regression coverage for street_road_lighting lamp ranking: without an application-key-specific scoring branch, every candidate in the wide LAD LED R700 family (50-2000W) tied at the same flat base score, so the top-N slice was decided by arbitrary DB collation order (observed picking a 1000W industrial floodlight for a dacha/garden pole query). Fixed by adding power-aware scoring for street_road_lighting that recognizes compact/residential context ("дача", "компактный", "участок") via stemmed query terms, and by widening application_recommendation's lamp fetch_limit so it is not truncated to an arbitrary DB-order slice before scoring ever sees the rest of the candidates.
